name: CSG Operations on Implicit Functions
definition: Compositing implicit functions using Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) operations: Union, Intersection, and Difference. These operations combine multiple implicit functions into a single implicit function that can be rendered by the bisection tracer.
summary: CSG Operations on Implicit Functions composite multiple primitive shapes into a single implicit surface by applying Boolean logic to their distance fields, enabling complex geometry rendering via arithmetic operations.
